name: Heimerdinger
text: Keywords: Imbue. When you play a spell, create a Fleeting Turret in hand with equal cost. It costs 0. Level up: I've seen you summon 12+ Power of Tech allies.

name: Iceborn Legacy
text: Grant an ally and all allied copies of it everywhere +2|+2.

name: Shipwreck Hoarder
text: Keywords: Deep. When I'm summoned, Toss 2 and create 2 Treasures in your deck.

name: Twisted Fate
text: Keywords: Quick Attack. Play: Play a Destiny Card. Level up: I've seen you draw 9 cards.

name: Aphelios
text: Nightfall: Pick a Moon Weapon to create in hand. Each round, the first time you play 2 other cards, create the Phased Moon Weapon in hand if you don't already have one. Level up: You've played 4+ Moon Weapons.

name: Lost Riches
text: Draw a Treasure. If there aren't any to draw, create 2 Treasures in your deck instead.

name: Bilgerat Rascal
text: Play: Discard 1 to Manifest a Mecha Yordle and grant it SpellShield.

name: Squeaker
text: Keywords: Augment. Play: Discard 1 to Manifest a Mecha Yordle.

name: Esmus, Breath of the World
text: Keywords: Elusive, Support. When I'm summoned, plant a Chime on the top card of your deck. Support: Grant my supported ally +1|+1.

name: Mystic Vortex
text: Keywords: Countdown, Landmark. When I'm summoned or when I count down, plant 3 Chimes in your deck. Countdown 2: Draw 1.

name: Cosmic Binding
text: Deal 2 to an enemy and Stun another. Plant 6 Chimes in your deck.

name: Byrd, The Bellringer
text: When I'm summoned, plant a Chime on the top card of your deck.

name: Maduli, The Gatekeeper
text: When I'm summoned, plant a Chime on the top card of your deck, then double the boons in your deck.

name: Magical Journey
text: Plant a Mysterious Portal in the top 4 cards of your deck and plant a Chime on the top card of your deck.

name: Eclectic Collection
text: For each ally, plant a Mysterious Portal and 3 Chimes in the top 10 cards of your deck and plant a Flashbomb Trap and 3 Poison Puffcaps in the enemy deck.

name: Lonely Chimeslime
text: Keywords: Last Breath. When another ally dies, or Last Breath: Plant 4 Chimes in your deck.

name: Bursting Backpack
text: For each Bursting Backpack you've played this game, plant 4 Chimes in your deck and 4 Poison Puffcaps in the enemy deck. Create a Bursting Backpack in your deck.

name: Dreamlight Alina
text: Keywords: Spirit. When I'm summoned, summon 5 Spritelings. For each one there isn't space for, grant the Weakest ally 2 Spirit instead.

name: Sprite Mother
text: When I'm summoned, grant allied Spritelings and Sprite Mothers Everywhere Spirit.

name: The Dewdrop Harvest
text: Keywords: Landmark. I: Summon Spritelings. II: Sleep an ally.

name: The Heart of the Tree
text: Keywords: Landmark. I: Heal your Nexus 3 and summon Spritelings. II: Grant allies Everywhere Spirit. III: Manifest a card that costs 8 or more and reduce its cost by half, rounded up.

name: Heimerdinger (level 2)
text: Keywords: Imbue. When you play a spell, create a Fleeting Turret in hand with equal cost. Grant it +1|+1 and it costs 0.

name: Twisted Fate (level 2)
text: Keywords: Quick Attack. Each round, the first 3 times you play a card, I play a Destiny Card.

name: Lee Sin (level 2)
text: Keywords: Imbue. When you play a spell, give me Challenger this round. If you play another, give me Barrier this round. I Dragon's Rage enemies that I Challenge.

name: Aphelios (level 2)
text: Keywords: Quick Attack, Missing Translation. Nightfall: Pick a Moon Weapon to create in hand. Each round, the first time you play 2 other cards or Round Start: Create the Phased Moon Weapon in hand if you don't already have one. Your Moon Weapons cost 1 less.

name: Azir (level 2)
text: When I level up, replace your deck with the Emperor's Deck, then draw 1. When allies attack, summon an attacking Sandstone Charger.

name: Mark of the Storm
text: Keywords: Fast, Fleeting. Grant an enemy Mark of the Storm. If they already have it, remove the mark to Stun and deal 2 to them instead.

name: Prank
text: Keywords: Focus. Pick 1 of 2 non-champion cards from the enemy hand or deck and Prank it.

name: Petal Pixie
text: When I'm summoned, summon Spritelings.

name: Spriteling Call
text: Keywords: Skill, Slow. Summon Spritelings.

name: Green Thumb
text: Keywords: Skill, Focus. Heal your Nexus 3 and summon Spritelings.
